rationale: Wide figured fiddleback slab, about 2 m; if genuine Huon pine likely $300-600, discounted for unverified species.
Narrow plain-grain slab with a dark knot; modest value even if Huon pine.
Medium slab with faint figure but a long crack through most of its length.
Narrow plain slab with bark both sides; limited yield.
Wide strongly figured slab with birdseye clusters; the best of the group if genuine.
Wide rippled slab but bark inclusions and voids reduce usable timber.
Medium straight-grain slab with a long split; species unverified.
Two narrow plain slabs, one short; value in quantity if Huon pine.
Long narrow slab with knots, splits and staining; species unconfirmed.
Shorter wide slab with birdseye-type flecks but splits and staining; species unconfirmed.
